test_title: PYST 61: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 17 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select 'No substitution'.

No matter how __hard work you__, your boss will not recognise your efforts.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect placement of the words "hard" and "work".
 
• The corrected phrase "hard you work" maintains the intended meaning and grammatical structure.
 
• Thus, the error is located in the underlined segment of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"No matter how hard you work, your boss will not recognise your efforts."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "work you do hard"** – This construction is awkward and does not fit the intended meaning.
 
• **Option 3: "hardly you work"** – This changes the meaning entirely, implying minimal effort rather than emphasizing hard work.
 
• **No substitution** – This would be correct if the original sentence was already correct, but it contains an error in word order.
